topic: Mutual Fund and ETF Fees and Expenses
source_evidence: The amount of this type of fee depends on how long you hold your shares and may gradually decline to zero if you hold your shares long enough.
answer: A contingent deferred sales charge (CDSC), also called a contingent deferred sales load, is a back-end sales charge: it may be deducted from the money you receive when you redeem mutual fund shares. The amount depends on how long you have held the shares and may gradually fall to zero if you hold them long enough. The prospectus discloses how the rate declines, so check it to understand the charge that may apply. A fund with a CDSC typically also has an annual 12b-1 fee.
